eval.description: Held-out multiple-choice eval of difficult radiological and nuclear expert and tacit knowledge. Eighty-seven questions cover exposure, device and infrastructure topics, acquisition paths, detector evasion, enrichment, and improvised devices. Written by Jake Hecla (MIT Laboratory for Nuclear Security and Policy); samples are not online. Scored as accuracy.
eval.summary: Measures how well the model answers hard expert questions about radiological and nuclear weapons risks.
